subsystem: Generator path: src/provider/{types,openrouter,anthropic,prompts,actions,sse,mock,null}.ts, core Provider contract (src/core/types.ts:402-466), config generator section (src/config/{defaults,types,resolve,validate}.ts), src/spend/meter.ts, plus the two call sites src/loop/stages/propose.ts and Engine.generate (src/loop/engine.ts:1696-1742)
summary: One LLM call site exists: the propose stage (src/loop/stages/propose.ts:27-35) builds a GenerateRequest {system = fixed per-run prompt (engine.ts:610, prompts.ts:96-124), messages = one user message per step (prompts.ts:266-283), maxTokens = cfg (default 4096), temperature = cfg (default null = parameter not sent), tools = [PROPOSE_ACTION_TOOL], toolChoice = {name:'propose_action'}} and calls ctx.generate → Engine.generate → Provider.generate. Both HTTP providers stream over raw fetch+SSE (sse.ts:157-226), retry 3 attempts with Anthropic-SDK backoff (sse.ts:232-242, 386-405), 30 s first-byte / 60 s idle timeouts, and accumulate tool-call argument fragments as strings, parsing once at end (openrouter.ts:207-213; anthropic.ts:244-251). actions.ts:190-206 turns GenerateResult into a Proposal: toolCalls[0].input first, else the last fenced json block; exact-key validation (actions.ts:104-175); a GeneratorResponseError gets one retry with reason + 500-char tail (propose.ts:41-51), the second failure ends the step. Cost: OpenRouter takes usage.cost from the accounting frame, else the pricing table when cfg.priced, else NaN → budget:unpriced → run stops unless --allow-unpriced (openrouter.ts:309; engine.ts:1550-1562, 1918-1923); Anthropic always prices from the table (anthropic.ts:338). The meter clamps NaN to 0 and sums generator+jev against the cap (meter.ts:19-31, 62-64). IN FLIGHT (uncommitted, not by me): defaults.ts:6-7 now DEFAULT_PROVIDER='openrouter', DEFAULT_MODEL='z-ai/glm-5.3-flash' with GLM pricing rows (defaults.ts:61-74: flash 0.09/0.30, cache read 0.018, cache write derived 0.1125); openrouter.ts:74 now sends parallel_tool_calls:false; types.ts:190-191 typed. That change currently fails 9 tests in test/unit/config/resolve.test.ts and leaves docs/.env.example/login/onboarding defaults stale. (a) GLM default: config side is done; remaining work is tests, docs, DECISIONS entry, CLI/onboarding fallbacks, bench default, `reasoning` handling and possibly provider.require_parameters. (b) N samples: `n` is NOT in the supplied GLM supported-parameter list (defaults.ts:58-59) nor in research 07 §2.2's OpenAPI field list, and Anthropic has no `n`; the OpenRouter parser reads choices index 0 only (openrouter.ts:144) → N samples must be N parallel requests; needs a sample id through Engine.generate, events, GeneratorCallRecord, retryHooks and timing. (c) Concurrency: provider objects are stateless closures (safe to share; the bench already does at runner.ts:510,636), but the engine has single-slot retry state (engine.ts:1524-1545), single-stream TUI events (types.ts:1114-1118), latency summed not wall-clocked (engine.ts:1731), and the mock provider has an ordered `calls` counter (mock.ts:37,44). Claude-specific assumptions are enumerated in hazards with a [claude-specific] prefix.
